# VLM acceptance numerical test-setting inventory

All literals are labeled SYNTHETIC TEST settings, indices, or sourced algebraic constants. Sources: MIT Lectures 8/9 and JVL (coefficients/ellipse), estimator geometry.md (area normalization), NASA grid-convergence tutorial (Richardson). Prediction-band construction is an explicitly empirical coarse-grid contraction hypothesis; no data from the held-out finest mesh sets its width. EPSILON is the Rust binary64 machine constant, not a physical tip value.
